# ============================================
# DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY ANALYSIS
# ============================================

library(foreign)
library(tidyverse)
library(geepack)
library(geesmv)
library(broom)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================
# 1. DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================

# Load data 
data <- read.dta("analysis_data.dta")

# Prepare analysis dataset
prepare_analysis_data <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      # Convert cluster to factor
      cluster = as.factor(cluster),

      # Create analysis variables for each condition
      # Condition 1
      cond1_accurate = as.numeric(cond1_psdiag == cond1_hwdiag),
      # Condition 2
      cond2_accurate = as.numeric(cond2_psdiag == cond2_hwdiag),

      # Intervention indicator
      arm_num = as.numeric(arm == "Intervention"),

      # Covariates
      wave_numeric = as.numeric(factor(
        wave,
        levels = c("Wave 1", "Wave 2", "Wave 3")
      )),
      age_centered = as.numeric(age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
      male = as.numeric(gender == "Male"),
      cluster_id = as.factor(cluster)
    ) %>%
    # Filter to analysis sample (patients with complete data)
    filter(
      (!is.na(cond1_psdiag) & !is.na(cond1_hwdiag)) |
        (!is.na(cond2_psdiag) & !is.na(cond2_hwdiag))
    )
}

# Prepare data
analysis_data <- prepare_analysis_data(data)

# Function to create condition-specific dataset
prepare_condition_data <- function(data, condition) {
  psdiag <- paste0(condition, "_psdiag")
  hwdiag <- paste0(condition, "_hwdiag")
  accurate <- paste0(condition, "_accurate")

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(psdiag)), !is.na(!!sym(hwdiag))) %>%
    mutate(
      accurate = !!sym(accurate),
      disease = !!sym(psdiag),
      test = !!sym(hwdiag)
    ) %>%
    select(
      accurate, disease, test, arm_num, cluster_id,
      wave_numeric, age, age_centered, male
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(wave_numeric),
      !is.na(age),
      !is.na(age_centered),
      !is.na(male)
    )
}

# Create condition-specific datasets
cond1_data <- prepare_condition_data(analysis_data, "cond1")
cond2_data <- prepare_condition_data(analysis_data, "cond2")

# ============================================
# 2. DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS - TABLE 4
# ============================================

create_table4 <- function() {
  bind_rows(
    cond1_data %>% mutate(condition = "Condition 1"),
    cond2_data %>% mutate(condition = "Condition 2")
  ) %>%
    group_by(condition, arm_num) %>%
    summarise(
      n_patients = n(),
      n_clusters = n_distinct(cluster_id),
      age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_sd = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_male = mean(male, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Create Table 4
table4 <- create_table4()

# ============================================
# 3. CLUSTER-LEVEL DIAGNOSTIC METRICS
# ============================================

calculate_cluster_metrics <- function(data, condition_name) {
  data %>%
    group_by(cluster_id, arm_num) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      TP = sum(disease == 1 & test == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      TN = sum(disease == 0 & test == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      FP = sum(disease == 0 & test == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      FN = sum(disease == 1 & test == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      condition = condition_name,
      arm = ifelse(arm_num == 1, "Intervention", "Control"),

      # Calculate metrics
      sensitivity = ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_),
      specificity = ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_),
      ppv = ifelse(TP + FP > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA_real_),
      npv = ifelse(TN + FN > 0, TN / (TN + FN), NA_real_),
      accuracy = (TP + TN) / N,

      # Format for display
      sensitivity_pct = sensitivity * 100,
      specificity_pct = specificity * 100,
      ppv_pct = ppv * 100,
      npv_pct = npv * 100,
      accuracy_pct = accuracy * 100,

      cluster_label = paste("Cluster", cluster_id)
    )
}

# Calculate cluster metrics
cond1_cluster <- calculate_cluster_metrics(cond1_data, "Condition 1")
cond2_cluster <- calculate_cluster_metrics(cond2_data, "Condition 2")

# ============================================
# 4. GEE ANALYSIS FUNCTION WITH KC CORRECTION
# ============================================

run_gee_kc <- function(formula, data, family = "binomial",
                       link = "logit", corstr = "exchangeable") {
  tryCatch({
    # Fit GEE model
    gee_fit <- geeglm(
      formula,
      family = binomial(link = link),
      data = data,
      id = cluster_id,
      corstr = corstr
    )

    # Apply KC correction
    kc_result <- GEE.var.kc(
      formula = formula,
      id = "cluster_id",
      family = family,
      data = data,
      corstr = corstr
    )

    # Extract coefficients and corrected SEs
    beta <- coef(gee_fit)
    kc_cov <- as.matrix(kc_result$cov.beta)

    # Check and align the covariance matrix with the model coefficients
    if (nrow(kc_cov) != length(beta) ||
        ncol(kc_cov) != length(beta)) {
      stop("KC covariance matrix dimensions do not match model coefficients.")
    }

    if (!is.null(rownames(kc_cov)) &&
        !is.null(colnames(kc_cov)) &&
        all(names(beta) %in% rownames(kc_cov)) &&
        all(names(beta) %in% colnames(kc_cov))) {
      kc_cov <- kc_cov[names(beta), names(beta), drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      dimnames(kc_cov) <- list(names(beta), names(beta))
    }

    kc_se <- sqrt(pmax(diag(kc_cov), 0))

    # Calculate degrees of freedom
    n_clusters <- n_distinct(data$cluster_id)
    n_params <- length(beta)
    df <- max(1, n_clusters - n_params - 1)

    # Calculate t-statistics and p-values
    t_stats <- beta / kc_se
    p_values <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stats), df = df)

    # Calculate confidence intervals using t-distribution
    t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = df)
    conf_low <- beta - t_crit * kc_se
    conf_high <- beta + t_crit * kc_se

    # Return results
    results <- data.frame(
      term = names(beta),
      estimate = as.numeric(beta),
      std.error = as.numeric(kc_se),
      statistic = as.numeric(t_stats),
      df = df,
      p.value = as.numeric(p_values),
      conf.low = as.numeric(conf_low),
      conf.high = as.numeric(conf_high)
    )

    # Retain covariance matrix for valid linear contrasts downstream
    attr(results, "kc_cov") <- kc_cov

    results
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Model failed:", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Calculate an estimate and standard error for a linear contrast
calculate_kc_contrast <- function(model, contrast_weights) {
  if (is.null(model) || nrow(model) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  kc_cov <- attr(model, "kc_cov")

  if (is.null(kc_cov)) {
    stop("KC covariance matrix was not retained for this model.")
  }

  beta <- setNames(model$estimate, model$term)

  if (!all(names(contrast_weights) %in% names(beta))) {
    stop("One or more contrast terms were not found in the fitted model.")
  }

  contrast_weights <- contrast_weights[names(contrast_weights)]
  estimate <- sum(contrast_weights * beta[names(contrast_weights)])

  contrast_cov <- kc_cov[
    names(contrast_weights),
    names(contrast_weights),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  variance <- as.numeric(
    t(as.matrix(contrast_weights)) %*%
      contrast_cov %*%
      as.matrix(contrast_weights)
  )

  se <- sqrt(max(variance, 0))
  df <- unique(model$df)
  t_stat <- estimate / se
  t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = df)

  data.frame(
    estimate = estimate,
    se = se,
    t_stat = t_stat,
    p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df),
    conf_low = estimate - t_crit * se,
    conf_high = estimate + t_crit * se,
    df = df
  )
}

# ============================================
# 5. OVERALL ACCURACY MODELS - TABLE 7
# ============================================

run_accuracy_models <- function(data, condition_name) {
  models <- list()

  for (corr in c("exchangeable", "independence")) {
    # Unadjusted
    unadj <- run_gee_kc(accurate ~ arm_num, data, corstr = corr)

    if (!is.null(unadj)) {
      unadj$model <- "unadjusted"
      unadj$correlation <- corr
      unadj$condition <- condition_name
      models[[paste(condition_name, corr, "unadj")]] <- unadj
    }

    # Adjusted
    adj <- run_gee_kc(
      accurate ~ arm_num + wave_numeric + age_centered + male,
      data,
      corstr = corr
    )

    if (!is.null(adj)) {
      adj$model <- "adjusted"
      adj$correlation <- corr
      adj$condition <- condition_name
      models[[paste(condition_name, corr, "adj")]] <- adj
    }
  }

  bind_rows(models)
}

# Run overall accuracy models
cond1_accuracy <- run_accuracy_models(cond1_data, "COND1")
cond2_accuracy <- run_accuracy_models(cond2_data, "COND2")
all_accuracy <- bind_rows(cond1_accuracy, cond2_accuracy)

# Format Table 7
table7 <- all_accuracy %>%
  filter(term == "arm_num") %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    OR_low = exp(conf.low),
    OR_high = exp(conf.high),
    display = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", OR, OR_low, OR_high)
  ) %>%
  select(
    condition, correlation, model, display,
    statistic, p.value, std.error, df
  )

# ============================================
# 6. SENSITIVITY/SPECIFICITY MODELS - TABLE 8
# ============================================

run_sens_spec_models <- function(data, condition_name) {
  results <- list()

  for (corr in c("exchangeable", "independence")) {
    # Unadjusted
    unadj <- run_gee_kc(test ~ disease * arm_num, data, corstr = corr)

    if (!is.null(unadj)) {
      # Extract coefficients for derived metrics
      beta2 <- unadj$estimate[unadj$term == "arm_num"]

      interaction_term <- if ("disease:arm_num" %in% unadj$term) {
        "disease:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:disease"
      }

      beta3 <- unadj$estimate[unadj$term == interaction_term]
      df <- unique(unadj$df)

      # Calculate sensitivity and specificity using the full covariance matrix
      sens <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        unadj,
        c(
          arm_num = 1,
          setNames(1, interaction_term)
        )
      )

      spec <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        unadj,
        c(arm_num = -1)
      )

      if (!is.null(sens) && !is.null(spec)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "unadj")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          model = "unadjusted",
          metric = c("sensitivity", "specificity"),
          OR = c(exp(sens$estimate), exp(spec$estimate)),
          OR_low = c(exp(sens$conf_low), exp(spec$conf_low)),
          OR_high = c(exp(sens$conf_high), exp(spec$conf_high)),
          t_stat = c(sens$t_stat, spec$t_stat),
          p_value = c(sens$p_value, spec$p_value),
          se = c(sens$se, spec$se),
          df = df
        )
      }
    }

    # Adjusted
    adj <- run_gee_kc(
      test ~ disease * arm_num + wave_numeric + age_centered + male,
      data,
      corstr = corr
    )

    if (!is.null(adj)) {
      interaction_term <- if ("disease:arm_num" %in% adj$term) {
        "disease:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:disease"
      }

      df <- unique(adj$df)

      sens <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        adj,
        c(
          arm_num = 1,
          setNames(1, interaction_term)
        )
      )

      spec <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        adj,
        c(arm_num = -1)
      )

      if (!is.null(sens) && !is.null(spec)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "adj")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          model = "adjusted",
          metric = c("sensitivity", "specificity"),
          OR = c(exp(sens$estimate), exp(spec$estimate)),
          OR_low = c(exp(sens$conf_low), exp(spec$conf_low)),
          OR_high = c(exp(sens$conf_high), exp(spec$conf_high)),
          t_stat = c(sens$t_stat, spec$t_stat),
          p_value = c(sens$p_value, spec$p_value),
          se = c(sens$se, spec$se),
          df = df
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run sensitivity/specificity models
cond1_sens_spec <- run_sens_spec_models(cond1_data, "COND1")
cond2_sens_spec <- run_sens_spec_models(cond2_data, "COND2")
all_sens_spec <- bind_rows(cond1_sens_spec, cond2_sens_spec)

# ============================================
# 7. PPV/NPV MODELS - TABLE 9
# ============================================

run_ppv_npv_models <- function(data, condition_name) {
  results <- list()

  for (corr in c("exchangeable", "independence")) {
    # Unadjusted
    unadj <- run_gee_kc(disease ~ test * arm_num, data, corstr = corr)

    if (!is.null(unadj)) {
      interaction_term <- if ("test:arm_num" %in% unadj$term) {
        "test:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:test"
      }

      df <- unique(unadj$df)

      # Calculate PPV and NPV using the full covariance matrix
      ppv <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        unadj,
        c(
          arm_num = 1,
          setNames(1, interaction_term)
        )
      )

      npv <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        unadj,
        c(arm_num = -1)
      )

      if (!is.null(ppv) && !is.null(npv)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "unadj")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          model = "unadjusted",
          metric = c("PPV", "NPV"),
          OR = c(exp(ppv$estimate), exp(npv$estimate)),
          OR_low = c(exp(ppv$conf_low), exp(npv$conf_low)),
          OR_high = c(exp(ppv$conf_high), exp(npv$conf_high)),
          t_stat = c(ppv$t_stat, npv$t_stat),
          p_value = c(ppv$p_value, npv$p_value),
          se = c(ppv$se, npv$se),
          df = df
        )
      }
    }

    # Adjusted
    adj <- run_gee_kc(
      disease ~ test * arm_num + wave_numeric + age_centered + male,
      data,
      corstr = corr
    )

    if (!is.null(adj)) {
      interaction_term <- if ("test:arm_num" %in% adj$term) {
        "test:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:test"
      }

      df <- unique(adj$df)

      ppv <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        adj,
        c(
          arm_num = 1,
          setNames(1, interaction_term)
        )
      )

      npv <- calculate_kc_contrast(
        adj,
        c(arm_num = -1)
      )

      if (!is.null(ppv) && !is.null(npv)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "adj")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          model = "adjusted",
          metric = c("PPV", "NPV"),
          OR = c(exp(ppv$estimate), exp(npv$estimate)),
          OR_low = c(exp(ppv$conf_low), exp(npv$conf_low)),
          OR_high = c(exp(ppv$conf_high), exp(npv$conf_high)),
          t_stat = c(ppv$t_stat, npv$t_stat),
          p_value = c(ppv$p_value, npv$p_value),
          se = c(ppv$se, npv$se),
          df = df
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run PPV/NPV models
cond1_ppv_npv <- run_ppv_npv_models(cond1_data, "COND1")
cond2_ppv_npv <- run_ppv_npv_models(cond2_data, "COND2")
all_ppv_npv <- bind_rows(cond1_ppv_npv, cond2_ppv_npv)

# ============================================
# 8. JOINT HYPOTHESIS TESTS - TABLE 10
# ============================================

run_joint_tests <- function(data, condition_name) {
  results <- list()

  # Helper function for a numerically stable Wald test
  calculate_joint_wald <- function(beta, vcov, contrast) {
    contrast_beta <- contrast %*% beta
    contrast_vcov <- contrast %*% vcov %*% t(contrast)

    if (any(!is.finite(contrast_vcov))) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (qr(contrast_vcov)$rank < nrow(contrast_vcov)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    statistic <- as.numeric(
      t(contrast_beta) %*% solve(contrast_vcov) %*% contrast_beta
    )

    list(
      statistic = statistic,
      p_value = pchisq(
        statistic,
        df = nrow(contrast),
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      df = nrow(contrast)
    )
  }

  for (corr in c("exchangeable", "independence")) {
    # Sensitivity/Specificity joint test
    ss_fit <- tryCatch(
      geeglm(
        test ~ disease * arm_num,
        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
        data = data,
        id = cluster_id,
        corstr = corr
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(paste("Sensitivity/specificity joint model failed:", e$message))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(ss_fit)) {
      ss_vcov <- ss_fit$geese$vbeta
      ss_beta <- coef(ss_fit)

      # Create contrast matrix for H0: β₂ = 0 AND β₂ + β₃ = 0
      interaction_term <- if ("disease:arm_num" %in% names(ss_beta)) {
        "disease:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:disease"
      }

      K_ss <- matrix(
        0,
        nrow = 2,
        ncol = length(ss_beta),
        dimnames = list(NULL, names(ss_beta))
      )

      K_ss[1, "arm_num"] <- 1
      K_ss[2, "arm_num"] <- 1
      K_ss[2, interaction_term] <- 1

      # Calculate Wald statistic
      joint_ss <- calculate_joint_wald(ss_beta, ss_vcov, K_ss)

      if (!is.null(joint_ss)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "sens_spec")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          test = "Sensitivity & Specificity",
          chisq = joint_ss$statistic,
          df = joint_ss$df,
          p_value = joint_ss$p_value
        )
      }
    }

    # PPV/NPV joint test
    pn_fit <- tryCatch(
      geeglm(
        disease ~ test * arm_num,
        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
        data = data,
        id = cluster_id,
        corstr = corr
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(paste("PPV/NPV joint model failed:", e$message))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(pn_fit)) {
      pn_vcov <- pn_fit$geese$vbeta
      pn_gamma <- coef(pn_fit)

      # Create contrast matrix for H0: γ₂ = 0 AND γ₂ + γ₃ = 0
      interaction_term <- if ("test:arm_num" %in% names(pn_gamma)) {
        "test:arm_num"
      } else {
        "arm_num:test"
      }

      K_pn <- matrix(
        0,
        nrow = 2,
        ncol = length(pn_gamma),
        dimnames = list(NULL, names(pn_gamma))
      )

      K_pn[1, "arm_num"] <- 1
      K_pn[2, "arm_num"] <- 1
      K_pn[2, interaction_term] <- 1

      joint_pn <- calculate_joint_wald(pn_gamma, pn_vcov, K_pn)

      if (!is.null(joint_pn)) {
        results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "ppv_npv")]] <- data.frame(
          condition = condition_name,
          correlation = corr,
          test = "PPV & NPV",
          chisq = joint_pn$statistic,
          df = joint_pn$df,
          p_value = joint_pn$p_value
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run joint tests
cond1_joint <- run_joint_tests(cond1_data, "COND1")
cond2_joint <- run_joint_tests(cond2_data, "COND2")
all_joint <- bind_rows(cond1_joint, cond2_joint)

# ============================================
# 9. IDENTITY LINK MODELS (Overall Accuracy) - TABLE 11
# ============================================

run_identity_accuracy <- function(data, condition_name) {
  results <- list()

  for (corr in c("exchangeable", "independence")) {
    # Unadjusted
    unadj <- run_gee_kc(
      accurate ~ arm_num,
      data,
      link = "identity",
      corstr = corr
    )

    if (!is.null(unadj) && nrow(unadj) > 0) {
      unadj$model <- "unadjusted"
      unadj$correlation <- corr
      unadj$condition <- condition_name
      results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "unadj")]] <- unadj
    }

    # Adjusted
    adj <- run_gee_kc(
      accurate ~ arm_num + wave_numeric + age_centered + male,
      data,
      link = "identity",
      corstr = corr
    )

    if (!is.null(adj) && nrow(adj) > 0) {
      adj$model <- "adjusted"
      adj$correlation <- corr
      adj$condition <- condition_name
      results[[paste(condition_name, corr, "adj")]] <- adj
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run identity link models
cond1_identity_acc <- run_identity_accuracy(cond1_data, "COND1")
cond2_identity_acc <- run_identity_accuracy(cond2_data, "COND2")
all_identity_acc <- bind_rows(cond1_identity_acc, cond2_identity_acc)

# ============================================
# 10. FIGURE 1 & 2: LINE PLOTS FOR CLUSTER METRICS
# ============================================

create_cluster_lineplot <- function(data, condition_name, metric_name) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(condition == condition_name) %>%
    group_by(arm) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[metric_name]]), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = rank,
      y = .data[[metric_name]],
      color = arm,
      group = arm
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = cluster_label),
      vjust = -0.8,
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(condition_name, "-", metric_name, "by Cluster"),
      x = "Rank within Arm (1 = Highest)",
      y = paste(metric_name, "(%)"),
      color = "Trial Arm"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

# ============================================
# 11. SUMMARY OUTPUT - TABLES 5 & 6
# ============================================

calculate_arm_metrics <- function(data, condition_name) {
  data %>%
    group_by(arm_num) %>%
    summarise(
      condition = condition_name,
      TP = sum(disease == 1 & test == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      FN = sum(disease == 1 & test == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      FP = sum(disease == 0 & test == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      TN = sum(disease == 0 & test == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      N = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      arm = ifelse(arm_num == 1, "Intervention", "Control"),
      sensitivity = ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_),
      specificity = ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_),
      ppv = ifelse(TP + FP > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA_real_),
      npv = ifelse(TN + FN > 0, TN / (TN + FN), NA_real_),
      accuracy = (TP + TN) / N
    )
}

# Tables 5 and 6
cond1_summary <- calculate_arm_metrics(cond1_data, "Condition 1")
cond2_summary <- calculate_arm_metrics(cond2_data, "Condition 2")

# ============================================
# 12. APPENDIX TABLES - CLUSTER SUMMARIES
# ============================================

create_cluster_summary <- function(data, condition_name, arm_name) {
  data %>%
    filter(condition == condition_name, arm == arm_name) %>%
    arrange(desc(sensitivity)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      sensitivity_display = sprintf("%.1f%%", sensitivity_pct),
      calculation = sprintf(
        "%d / (%d + %d) = %d/%d",
        TP, TP, FN, TP, TP + FN
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      rank, cluster_label, N, TP, FN,
      sensitivity_display, calculation
    )
}

# Create cluster summaries (Tables 16-19)
cond1_control_summary <- create_cluster_summary(
  all_cluster_data, "Condition 1", "Control"
)
cond1_intervention_summary <- create_cluster_summary(
  all_cluster_data, "Condition 1", "Intervention"
)
cond2_control_summary <- create_cluster_summary(
  all_cluster_data, "Condition 2", "Control"
)
cond2_intervention_summary <- create_cluster_summary(
  all_cluster_data, "Condition 2", "Intervention"
)
